_doc: The seat runtime's inference ladder — sealed decision c8572a92's sibling, pair 3613d55e (seat-runtime-provider-ladder-2026-09-20).
Data, not code: a rung is (provider, dialect, base_url, key_env, models, budget, issued). Free tiers first, Ollama floor, Anthropic by task class.
A 429 / quota / timeout on one rung steps to the next in the class's ladder; every wake inks provider+model+rung+tokens so 'cheapest-capable' is measured, not assumed.
Keys are NAMES here, never values. Values live only in $WILLOW_HOME/env on the host (Kart's kart_env prefix list) — this file must never hold one.
Free-tier limits move; `budget` is what the operator believed at `verify_at`, and the ladder should refuse to trust a rung whose verify_at is older than rotate_after_days.
status: unmeasured until the first wake inks a receipt on that rung; the steward tick may flip it to measured/degraded from receipts.

Every rung a class names must carry a models.<class> entry; ratatosk.ladder refuses the file otherwise (a rung with no model for the class could never be tried, and a silent skip would hide the hole).

budget.note: measured 2026-09-29 from x-ratelimit headers: 1000 requests/day, 8000 tokens/minute per model — the tokens/minute cap is the one a multi-turn wake meets first, so every class that names groq names a second provider after it. llama-3.3-70b-versatile and llama-3.1-8b-instant are gone from the catalog.

_classes_doc: Order within a class is the fall-through order. 'audit' keeps a cross-model rung above the builder's ladder on purpose: an audit on the same model family that built the thing is not an audit. Since 2026-09-29 build runs on qwen and audit on gpt-oss / nemotron; no audit model shares a family with a build model.

'audit' leads with openrouter, not groq: a woken seat's first turn (persona + tool definitions + brief) measured 13138 tokens on 2026-09-29, over groq's 8000 tokens-per-minute cap for any single request, so groq comes last. Since 2026-09-30 the second audit rung is openrouter-ultra (nemotron-3-ultra, probed in Kart HL30MQY9): cerebras's gpt-oss-120b answered 402 payment_required on the first real audit (B4871ED9) and left the class. A router built by from_args also walks once more, after a pause, over the rungs that refused transiently (ratatosk.inference.TRANSIENT_KINDS).

'audit' names no paid rung (pair a169d5ed, amending c9ca1a09 for seat audits): a rate limit steps to the next free provider, never to Opus. A paid audit is the operator's explicit ask, not a fall-through.
Names match dispatch task_class / the envelope task classes (build-work-order -> build, auditor -> audit, librarian -> research, operator -> operate, witness -> witness).
xAI/Grok is not a rung: console.x.ai went paid (operator, 2026-09-20).
